projects.title: GovAssist
projects.description: A versioned public-policy assistant that applies deterministic checks, verifies its output, and returns cited evidence instead of unsupported answers.
projects.decision: Selected for its clear engineering depth, measurable verification layer, and strong end-to-end demonstration.

projects.title: FoundIt
projects.description: A controlled lost-and-found workflow with structured reports, transparent match ranking, claim verification, notifications, and one recorded handover per item.
projects.decision: Retained as an achievable alternative, but not selected because campus adoption and differentiation remain uncertain.

projects.title: LaunchPad
projects.description: A placement-readiness system that maps skill evidence to versioned company criteria, identifies eligibility gaps, and builds focused roadmaps.
projects.decision: Retained for its measurable value, but ranked below GovAssist because reliable institutional criteria are difficult to source.

projects.title: Foresight
projects.description: A workload-forecasting and constraint-aware planning tool that detects overloaded weeks and moves only work that can be completed earlier.
projects.decision: The strongest algorithmic alternative, but it depends on a historical effort dataset that must first be created.

planningPresentation.title: Planning Presentation v1
planningPresentation.changeSummary: Initial planning baseline: four proposals evaluated and GovAssist selected for implementation.
planningPresentation.description: The planning record for GovAssist: project scope, intended users, system boundaries, quality targets, risks, ownership, and delivery milestones.
planningPresentation.scope: GovAssist helps citizens and small businesses map their facts to applicable public-scheme and tax rules. The MVP covers typed inputs, ITR selection, and two schemes; uncertain cases must abstain and point to the official source.
objectives: Return a decision with understandable reasoning and direct evidence.
Keep rule versions explicit so an answer can be reproduced later.
Block unsupported conclusions before they reach the user.
Handle uploaded documents without exposing unnecessary personal data.
functions: Verification, confidence, and cited answer output
Versioned rule administration and audit history
intendedUsers: Individuals choosing an appropriate ITR form
Small businesses interpreting selected public rules

architecture.title: Frontend
architecture.description: Responsive intake, document upload, decision summary, citations, and an administrative rule interface.

architecture.title: Application API
architecture.description: Authentication, validation, policy routing, orchestration, and access control around every request.

architecture.title: Rules and verification
architecture.description: Versioned deterministic checks, retrieved clauses, confidence handling, and a gate for unsupported claims.

architecture.title: Data and files
architecture.description: Relational metadata, immutable rule versions, audit events, and private object storage for documents.

qualityGoals.title: Performance
items: Useful first response target under 3 seconds
Bounded document size and processing time

qualityGoals.title: Security
items: TLS in transit and no secrets in the client

qualityGoals.title: Reliability
items: Reproducible answers against a rule version

risks.response: Store effective dates and never overwrite a published rule version.
Minimise retention, validate uploads, and allow typed-input fallback.

risks.risk: The system sounds certain when evidence is weak
risks.response: Require citations and make the verifier abstain on unsupported output.
Set quotas, monitor usage, and retain a deterministic no-OCR path.

milestones.title: Data model, auth, and API skeleton
